note: Read from the Figma page tree (MCP get_metadata on the page node), not from the library export: the export lists published nodes only, so the rows marked inLibrary: false exist nowhere else. One row per component and component set drawn on the page with the decision the library gives it, and one row per composition the page draws with the cases that measure it. A drawing that was never published is out of the implementation scope, so its decision is `unpublished` and no work follows; publishing it is what opens the decision, and the inLibrary mirror in `figma:check` is what makes that fail loudly. See .agents/skills/figma-to-code/references/catalogue.md.

identities.name: .Connector
identities.reason: A 2x35 rail segment drawn between two rows. Not published; the row draws its own rail as a pseudo-element, the same way the three .Position/* share their rendering.

identities.name: .TimelineDot
identities.reason: Fifteen cursors: Variant Filled|Outlined x Color Neutral|Primary|Secondary|Error|Warning|Info|Success x Size Big|Small (Small only for Filled and Neutral, 24x24 each). Not published — the four .TimelineDot/* that ship are standalone components, not variants of this set.

identities.name: .Position/Top
identities.reason: The share and the connector belong to the row, so the position is derived from the row's place in the list and the component draws no separate element.

identities.name: .Position/Middle
identities.reason: Same as .Position/Top: the rail above and below a middle row is the row's own pseudo-element.

identities.name: .Position/Bottom
identities.reason: Same as .Position/Top: the last row draws a single rail.

identities.name: .Position/OnlyElement
identities.reason: The position of a list holding one element, where no rail is drawn at all. Not published; the row derives it from the child count.

compositions.name: Frame 2087324448
compositions.reason: The desktop page 10981:11294 draws four TimelineElement at 852 in an 852 column, 136, 136, 116 and 116 high. No case measures the stack: the desktop case measures the set's own variant box (848) and no story frames four rows in a column, so the 136-to-116 difference between a full row and the last two is measured nowhere.

compositions.name: Frame 2087324448
compositions.reason: The mobile page 10981:11795 draws four TimelineElement at 304 inside a 320 page, 8px inset, 248, 248, 178 and 146 high. The mobile case measures 417 — the drawer's desktop panel — and the SourceCase story renders device="desktop", so no case measures the 304 the mobile page draws.

compositions.name: XS Mobile
compositions.reason: The drawer at the XS breakpoint: a 320 backdrop holding Timeline drawer at 320x1914. The drawer is pending and no story builds it; this frame is the only place the 320 width is drawn, and the registry note asks about a bottom sheet instead.

compositions.name: SM Tablet
compositions.reason: The drawer from SM up: a 600 backdrop holding Timeline drawer at 417, the width the MD, LG and XL frames draw too. That 417 is what the case labelled mobile measures, which is why it is not a mobile measurement.
